day_shape: 92 items: Trump signs Graham Russia-Iran sanctions implementation order, Netanyahu publicly names Iranian regime change as Israel's 'primary objective', FT reports Trump vetoed an October 10 IDF strike plan on Iran, USS Theodore Roosevelt deploying to Middle East, Iran strikes Kurdish opposition near Erbil, UK re-arrests two over RAF base Iran-intel probe.

threads.label: US-Israel calibrate next Iran strike
threads.summary: The Financial Times reported the IDF was ready to resume a multi-day operation against Iran on the weekend of October 10 but cancelled after Trump opposition, while the Pentagon is reportedly sending the USS Theodore Roosevelt strike group and a Marine unit to the region. Jerusalem Post sources said the Trump administration came 'very close' to approving an Iran strike on at least one recent occasion.

threads.label: Netanyahu names regime change as goal
threads.summary: Netanyahu confirmed he discussed 'the importance of eliminating Iran's regime' with Trump on Sunday and told Israeli media toppling Tehran was Israel's 'primary objective', one day after an unannounced visit by US War Secretary Pete Hegseth. Iran International reported Israeli opposition rivals are pressing for tougher measures ahead of the Israeli election.

threads.label: Mediation channels through Pakistan and Qatar
threads.summary: Pakistan's army chief Asim Munir left Tehran after meeting Pezeshkian and Ghalibaf, with Iran reiterating conditions for US talks and ruling out transferring enriched uranium abroad, while Iran's Nournews reported a Qatari delegation arrived in Tehran. Foreign Minister Araghchi told IRIB Iran has presented its plan to Washington tied to Strait of Hormuz conditions, and said Saudi Arabia and the Houthis have not responded to a separate mediation initiative.

threads.label: Iran strikes Kurdish opposition in Iraq
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post citing security sources reported a missile strike on an Iranian Kurdish opposition camp near Erbil and a separate attack on a Kurdistan Freedom Party (PAK) site in the Balisan Valley. Kurdish opposition forces separately killed an IRGC captain near the Iraq-Iran border, and Iraq closed one southern crossing with Iran as the US reportedly pressed Baghdad to shut border crossings.

threads.label: Sanctions, UK arrests, influence ops
threads.summary: The White House published a presidential document implementing the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026, and UK police re-arrested two men on suspicion of assisting Iranian intelligence as part of an investigation into activity at an RAF base. Iran International, citing The Times, reported Iran is accused of amplifying French unrest through online influence operations.

threads.label: IDF Gaza strikes on named Hamas operatives
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet said strikes in Gaza killed Akram Bassam Shaaban Yassin of Hamas's General Security Mechanism, Tamer Mohammad Ibrahim Al-Zabaq (said to be the final member of the cell that abducted Shani Louk on October 7), and Nukhba operative Musa Abd Muhammad Hamouda, linked to a 2025 attack that killed four tank crew. The IDF also said it had provided video evidence of Hezbollah still moving weapons the Lebanese Army claimed to have seized, while Israeli and Lebanese officials met at CENTCOM in Tampa.

threads.label: Iranian wartime messaging and economy
threads.summary: IRIB quoted Pezeshkian saying Iran is 'not seeking war' but will not bow to US pressure, while Defa Press carried armed forces spokesman Shakarchi telling Trump and Netanyahu they are 'on a downward slope to collapse' and Interior Ministry officials said elections and development continue under 'war conditions'. IRIB reported the Tehran general stock index fell 99,083 units to 8.173 million, cabinet reviewed reconstruction of South Pars oil and gas facilities, and UNHCR warned of cascading protection risks for Afghans in Iran from the 2026 military escalation.
